versions.content: Blueprinting BswEntryRelationshipSet The BswEn- tryRelationshipSet describes a collection of BswEntryRelationship s. A BswEntryRelationship describes a relationship between two BswModuleEntry s and the type of relationship. This is typically used to express that a concrete BswModuleEntry is derived from an abstract BswModuleEntry . In this case the bswEntryRelationshipType is set to derivedFrom , the BswEntryRelation- ship . from references the abstract BswModuleEntry and the BswEntryRela- tionship . to references the concrete BswModuleEntry .
